minor.issue: Unicode/space/special-char paths break the planned-vs-touched self-verify and abort the entire sync with exit 1 ('internal check failed — unexpected paths'), so no sync at all is published if main introduces such a file. `out('diff','--name-only',target,commit)` returns C-quoted paths like `"assets/weird dir/r\303\251sum\303\251 spaced.txt"` while `planned` holds the raw UTF-8 path, so `touched <= planned` is False. Scenario (h) in adversarial run. Fix: use `-z` + NUL split, e.g. `touched = {p for p in out('diff','--name-only','-z',target,commit).split(chr(0)) if p}` (or add `-c core.quotepath=false`). This matches how `changed` is already computed on line 270.

For the unicode-path regression, repro: create a file at 'assets/weird dir/résumé spaced.txt' on main in a /tmp sandbox bare clone, run `python3 scripts/sync_whitelabel.py --push`; before the fix the self-verify raises 'internal check failed — unexpected paths' and exits 1 with WL unchanged; after fix it should succeed and WL should contain the file. /tmp/gh is a read-only mirror of real GitHub, keep it. /tmp/adv is a scratch sandbox. Real repo was NEVER pushed to.
rca of the issue: File: /app/scripts/sync_whitelabel.py, line 375 — `touched = set(out('diff', '--name-only', target, commit).splitlines())`. With default `core.quotepath=true`, git encodes non-ASCII/space bytes in paths using C-escape quoting, so `touched` contains strings like `"assets/weird dir/r\303\251sum\303\251 spaced.txt"` (including surrounding quotes) while `planned` (built from the raw `changed` list computed with `-z` on line 270) contains the UTF-8 path. The subset check `touched <= planned` therefore fails and raises RuntimeError, which main() catches and exits 1 — nothing is pushed. Reproduction: scenario (h) in the adversarial run. Mitigation: switch line 375 to `touched = {p for p in out('diff', '--name-only', '-z', target, commit).split(chr(0)) if p}` (preferred — mirrors line 270) or prefix the git call with `-c core.quotepath=false`. Scenario (i) was then re-run in isolation and confirmed 100755 exec mode is preserved end-to-end.
